text: Great app. One issue. When I am offline and I don't have the premium, a text appears saying that I am offline and to use offline mode I have to buy premium. But the text is white and somehow the background whitens too after a while. Ergo the pop up window is unreadable. I don't know if anyone else has this problem or if it is due to my mobile phone.
author: Jindřich Dvořáček
developer_reply: Hi Jindřich, sorry about that, I'll check it out, maybe it is a bug related to dark mode! I hope the app helps a lot :)

text: Free verze dovolí jen tři položky, líbí se mi statistiky, nelze vyzkoušet bez založení účtu
author: Daniel Černý
developer_reply: Ahoj Danieli, v 7denní bezplatné zkušební verzi si můžete vyzkoušet plnou verzi zdarma. Jako nezávislý vývojář musím v určitém okamžiku účtovat, abych mohl pracovat na vylepšení aplikace. Musíte si vytvořit účet, aby bylo možné synchronizovat vaše data mezi všemi zařízeními, ve kterých lze aplikaci používat (web, mobil, tablet).

author: Uživatel Googlu

text: Nice looking app. But please add widgets for Launcher (e.g. similar widgets like in Loop - Habit tracker app), landscape orientation should be supported too and fix some keyboard issues on some text fields (e.g. title/description, I can't copy/paste and editing is somehow weird), maybe allow custom skip rules (not only weekends but also support customs like every 2 days or so?). I hope you will keep improving the app and adding new features 👍
author: Uživatel Googlu
developer_reply: Thanks for your feedback Robert! I am working on the widget and I hope it will be ready soon. Landscape is supported on tablets and I plan to support it back on mobile in the future, it's just quite complex to get it to work beautifully on every device. You can also use custom skips by double tapping each cell. I'll keep working on it every day! :)

author: Uživatel Googlu
developer_reply: Thank you! If it were perfect it'd have 5 stars so let me know how can I improve it at joan@everyday.app ;DD
